verdict.rationale: Simular's marketing says Sai can be taught a task once and then "reruns on a schedule", so scheduled runs are a first-party claim. Tasks can also be started non-interactively from external code via the documented `POST /v1/agents/message` endpoint, Python SDK and MCP server, with saved replayable skills that take parameters. However, the scheduling claim is a single marketing line with no configuration docs, and there is no documented native event-trigger mechanism; an external event can only start a task through custom code calling the API. Missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (cron/recurrence options), a native external-event or inbound-trigger mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs.
